entities.name: PMID:25074975
observations: A study of 20 healthy young men used two nights of 128-channel EEG, automated spindle detection, thalamic magnetic resonance spectroscopy, and the Magical Ideation Scale.

entities.name: Spindle density associations
observations: In 20 healthy young men, spindle density inversely correlated with magical-ideation schizotypy (r = −0.64, P < .01) and thalamic Glx (r = −0.70, P < .005); Glx and magical ideation were not significantly correlated (r = 0.12, P > .1).
